case_number: Civil Appeal No. 1392 of 2023 (Arising out of SLP(Civil) No. 11237 of 2022)
summary: Internal management dispute in AIADMK party concerning amendments to byelaws, creation of Co-ordinator and Joint Co-ordinator posts after the demise of the General Secretary, and conflicting claims over leadership. The case involved challenges to orders on interim injunctions relating to General Council and Executive Committee meetings, particularly those dated 23.06.2022 and 02.09.2022. Key issues: maintainability of temporary injunctions, status quo, and authority to convene party meetings. The Court focused on interim relief aspects without delving into broader leadership disputes, noting that civil suits remain pending.
legal_provisions_cited: Election Commission of India (registration of political parties)
final_judgment: The appeals were heard together; the Court confined its decision to the question of temporary injunctions, noting supervening events have rendered some orders moot, with civil suits still pending trial.
